column2: `AryShared` is a C fixture of mruby's test driver; neither driver installs it.
register window of calls (#3783) expects `/static/` to raise NoMethodError, which holds only in a build without `Regexp`; SabiRuby has mruby-regexp (`docs/verification/mrbtest-notes.md`).
Every assert calls `__env_*`, C fixtures of mruby's test driver; neither driver installs them.
a NaN is the object it is and no other also fails with rc2's tests: a deliberate deviation (`docs/verification/mrbtest-notes.md`).
`__gc_add_region_undersized` is a C fixture of mruby's test driver.

The four tests expect `eql?` to be asked of entries whose hash code differs from the key's, as mruby's Hash does; SabiRuby asks it of entries with the same hash code only. A deviation decided for 0.7.0 (`docs/verification/mrbtest-notes.md`), asked again in `docs/plans/edge-diff-fix-plan.md` D5.
`TestNotImplement` and `__iv_set_hidden` are C fixtures of mruby's test driver (SabiRuby's mrbtest has the first, so the reference column passes those).
One test names `TestNotImplement`, a C fixture of mruby's test driver.
`Range#last` on an endless range: mruby-range-ext's `last` raises RangeError, as the reference `mruby` command does on the same assertion (`docs/verification/mrbtest-notes.md`).
`Mrbtest.nofree_cstr?` is a C fixture of mruby's test driver.
The file stops at a top-level use of `TestNotImplement`, a C fixture (runtime_error). "pattern matching - a key that moves the subject" also fails with rc2's tests: a deliberate deviation.
`TestSysFail` is a C fixture of mruby's test driver.
`TestVFormat` is a C fixture of mruby's test driver.
